content.short: Notcoin is the viral 'Tap-to-Earn' game on Telegram that onboarded millions of users to the TON ecosystem.
content.description: Notcoin is a groundbreaking and viral 'Tap-to-Earn' social game that famously onboarded tens of millions of users to the TON blockchain through the Telegram interface. With its incredibly simple and addictive core mechanic—tapping a digital coin to earn—Notcoin demystified blockchain technology for the masses. The project culminated in one of the largest airdrops in history, distributing tokens to millions of active players and establishing Notcoin as a major cultural and economic phenomenon within the TON ecosystem and the broader crypto world.
content.meta: Experience the viral sensation Notcoin. The ultimate Tap-to-Earn game on TON, featured on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
